This Writ Petition has been filed for a Mandamus to direct the 2 nd Respondent herein, the District Collector for land acquisition proceedings to re-determine the compensation payable to the petitioner in respect of lands ____________ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis acquired bearing survey numbers 343/3 and 345/3c to an extent of 0.32 cents and 0.19 cents respectively situated at Sholinganallur Village, Tambaram Taluk, Kancheepuram District, now Chennai District under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 pursuant to the Order passed in W.P.No.6865 of 2006 dated 03.09.2010 and communication dated 20.06.2019 by the 5th Respondent to the 2nd Respondent and communication dated 25.02.2020 by the 3rd Respondent to the 5th Respondent.
2.
Heard the learned counsel on either side.

3. Perusal of the records of the papers would indicate that earlier the Petitioner's father had filed a Writ Petition in W.P.No.6865 of 2006 for the very same relief i.e., to quash the Land Acquisition proceedings and to re-determine the compensation under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894.

sentences.text: Though the Order was passed as early as on 03.09.2010, the Respondents did not comply with the order and even after several representations made thereafter, it has not been taken into consideration.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this Writ Petition is allowed by directing the Respondents to pass appropriate orders on merits and in accordance with law within a period of three (3) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this Order.
No costs.

Failing which, the District Collector shall be present on 02.12.2024.
